source: real capture (aircrack-ng test suite), raw IEEE 802.11 (LINKTYPE 105) - NO radiotap header
description: Sustained deauthentication storm: 6,153 Deauthentication frames over a 380.5 s capture, overwhelmingly reason code 7 (Class 3 frame received from nonassociated station), plus 29 Disassociations and a 3.3% retry rate.

captureQuality.notes: No radiotap header at all: no RSSI, no channel, no rate, no MCS. Any rule emitting signal strength, channel utilisation or PHY-rate findings from this file is wrong. capinfos reports the file was cut short in the middle of the final packet after 20,056 complete frames; the engine should surface that as a file-integrity note (partial trailing record), NOT as per-frame snaplen truncation.

deauthentication.distribution: sustained across the whole capture; ~768-772 deauths in each populated 30 s bucket (buckets 0,1,2,4,5,6,9,11), i.e. roughly 16 deauth/s while active - not one isolated burst

groundTruth.eapolNote: EAPOL-Key frames (type 3) appear only late in the capture, from frame 16714 onward

mustReport.detail: 6,153 Deauthentication frames over 378.6 s (first t+0.32 s, last t+378.88 s), 6,145 of them reason code 7 (Class 3 frame received from nonassociated station). 6,145 of 6,153 concentrate on the single pair 8c:de:f9:d0:b4:61 <-> 60:7e:a4:4c:ee:73 in both directions, ~16 deauth/s while active. Finding text must name reason code 7 explicitly, not a generic 'deauthentication detected'.

Deauthentication frames present; minor reason codes 2 (Previous authentication no longer valid, x4) and 3 (Deauthenticated because sending STA is leaving, x3) also observed alongside the dominant code 7
29 Disassociation frames across reason codes 4 (x15), 2 (x11) and 8 (x1); 2 frames carry no readable reason code
663 of 20,056 frames carry the retry bit (3.3%)

certaintyGovernance.reasonCodeDecoding: reason code 7 must be decoded and named; the 1 protected Deauth and the 2 protected Disassocs must be reported as reason code unavailable, never folded into the code-7 tally
certaintyGovernance.rssi: withheld - no radiotap header exists in this capture
certaintyGovernance.channel: withheld - no radiotap header exists in this capture
certaintyGovernance.deauthCause: at most 'likely' - a code-7 storm is consistent with a deauth-flood attack, a confused AP/STA state machine, or a driver bug; the engine must not assert 'attack' with 'observed' certainty
certaintyGovernance.aggregation: 6,153 deauth frames must collapse into at most 2 findings; per-frame emission is a failure

notes: Item 15 has three halves. This file covers retry rate + deauth volume + reason-code decoding on raw 802.11 with no radiotap. real/wpa-test-decode-mgmt.pcap covers 'reason code correctly withheld under PMF'. real/wpa-Induction.pcap covers the radiotap/signal dimension and the 3.2% retry baseline. Retry rate here (3.3%) is intentionally close to wpa-Induction (3.2%): a retry-rate threshold must classify both consistently. Also a performance fixture: 20,056 frames with 6,153 management frames of the same subtype must not degrade the rule pass.
